answer: Admission runs on live cross-examination: each epoch a VRF draw sends every candidate five one-shot probes from random established peers, each aimed at a distinct vertex of its published contact graph, with answers due in a fixed latency window at the certified inlet it registered. Each puppet must keep its own vertex reachable around the clock and recount its own past actions coherently, so cost grows linearly with bot count, no batch discount. Probes still fire at an account's activity nadir - one per epoch - so silence never exempts a bot. Honest users expose one inlet once and pay once.
